rows: Why does high ISO cause noise?
Amplification magnifies read noise; DR lost from top
Why can't you just boost shadows in post?
Shot noise already present; ISO-invariant sensors do allow it
Green carries luminance — resolution sensitive to green channel
Rolling vs global shutter: which is better?
Global for any fast motion; rolling fine for static
Why does APS-C have less background blur?
Smaller sensor = smaller aperture for same DoF = fewer photons
Diffraction: when does stopping down hurt?
Past f/8 for most modern sensors; f/5.6 for high-MP APS-C
Why does BSI improve low light?
Higher fill factor — more photons reach photodiode
Can a phone sensor match full frame?
No — photon count is a physics limit; computational can help but not overcome
